mapper.select: /* CastChknMapper.retrieveCknctCntList */ SELECT SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) AS ISLAND, COUNT(A.CKNCT_ID) AS CKNCT_CNT FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_CKNCT A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.CKNCT_USE_CRG_APLCN_TYPE_CD IN ('A', 'B') GROUP BY SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) ORDER BY ISLAND

/* CastChknMapper.retrievePsgWtngSumBySlotList */ SELECT T.SLOT_HHMM AS TIME, T.WTNG_PSG_CNT FROM ( SELECT S.SLOT_HHMM, S.WTNG_PSG_CNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY S.SLOT_HHMM ORDER BY S.PSG_FLOW_DATA_CRT_DT DESC) AS RN FROM ( SELECT A.PSG_FLOW_DATA_CRT_DT, SUBSTR(A.PSG_FLOW_DATA_CRT_DT, 9, 2) || CASE WHEN SUBSTR(A.PSG_FLOW_DATA_CRT_DT, 11, 2) < '30' THEN '00' ELSE '30' END AS SLOT_HHMM, NVL(SUM(A.WTNG_LINE_LEN), 0) AS WTNG_PSG_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_PSG_WTNG_INFO A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.PSG_FLOW_DATA_CRT_DT BETWEEN #{ymd} || '0000' AND #{ymd} || '2359' AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND A.FCLT_TYPE_CD = 'Queue' AND A.FCLT_NM NOT LIKE '%-SBD' GROUP BY A.PSG_FLOW_DATA_CRT_DT ) S ) T WHERE T.RN = 1 ORDER BY TIME
